required_outcomes: Recognises Ben's email as the landlord's written agreement to end the tenancy early on 10 November 2026 and records it.
Confirms to Tom in writing that the tenancy ends on 10 November by agreement with the landlord, with rent due up to that date and no extra month.
Starts the move-out workflow: checkout arranged or proposed, key return, and the mydeposits return process.
Handles it without escalating: the landlord has decided and the next steps are routine.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Tom to confirm by reply that he accepts the 10 November date before booking the checkout.
positive_behaviours: Acknowledges Ben's instruction to re-market from mid-November and arranges viewings only with Tom's agreement and notice.
Explains the deposit timescale fairly (within 10 days of the amount being agreed after checkout).
red_flags: Still telling Tom the tenancy ends on 10 December.
Escalating a decision the landlord has already made in writing.
prohibited_actions: Charging Tom an early-release or admin fee for the agreed early end.
critical_failures: Telling Tom he owes rent to 10 December despite the landlord's written agreement to 10 November.
